description:
Subject: Unit Compendium – Support & Assault Characters

The roster currently includes two fully defined units. The first entry, identified as **unit_001**, is the **Aether Sentinel** (Support). This floating guardian’s description reads: “A floating guardian that channels celestial energy to protect its allies.” Its combat profile lists an offense rating of **45.2**, defense of **78.9**, and a speed of **30.5**. Visual assets are tied to the files **overlay_aether.png** and **underlay_aether.png**. The Sentinel ships with two cosmetic skins: Skin #1, **Celestial Dawn**, marked as the default appearance, uses the icon **skin_celestial_dawn.png**, and unlocks with items **101** and **102**; Skin #2, **Void Whisper**, is non‑default, uses **skin_void_whisper.png**, and requires items **201**, **202**, and **203**.

The second entry, **unit_002**, is the **Ironclad Ravager** (Assault). Its description states: “A heavily armored war machine that crushes obstacles with brute force.” Its statistics are an offense of **92.7**, defense of **65.4**, and speed of **22.1**. The associated graphics are **overlay_ironclad.png** for the overlay and **underlay_ironclad.png** for the underlay. This unit offers three skins: Skin #3, **Red Tide**, is the default skin, displays the icon **skin_red_tide.png**, and unlocks with item **301**; Skin #4, **Steelforge**, is a non‑default option, uses **skin_steelforge.png**, and requires items **401**, **402**, **403**, and **404**; Skin #5, **Nightmare**, also non‑default, shows **skin_nightmare.png** and unlocks with items **501** and **502**.
